meta.title: Battle Dialogue · Hail Mary
meta.description: I am a Doll that makes the impossible possible.

units.rawText: Backup data recovery 95% complete.
units.displayText: Backup data recovery 95% complete.

spans.text: Backup data recovery 95% complete.

units.rawText: Inside the base's generator complex.
units.displayText: Inside the base's generator complex.

spans.text: Inside the base's generator complex.

units.rawText: The agent team hides behind the surrounding machinery. Their luminescent little eyes stare at the entropics before them.
units.displayText: The agent team hides behind the surrounding machinery. Their luminescent little eyes stare at the entropics before them.

spans.text: The agent team hides behind the surrounding machinery. Their luminescent little eyes stare at the entropics before them.

units.rawText: Fortunately, the situation isn't too bad; only a few entropics have entered the complex.
units.displayText: Fortunately, the situation isn't too bad; only a few entropics have entered the complex.

spans.text: Fortunately, the situation isn't too bad; only a few entropics have entered the complex.

units.rawText: S901, confirmed target location. Target locked.
units.displayText: S901, confirmed target location. Target locked.

spans.text: S901, confirmed target location. Target locked.

units.rawText: Generator No. 6 not in firing range. Operation stable.
units.displayText: Generator No. 6 not in firing range. Operation stable.

spans.text: Generator No. 6 not in firing range. Operation stable.

units.rawText: S901 braces the machine gun. Once the entropic's movements become predictable, he pulls the trigger.
units.displayText: S901 braces the machine gun. Once the entropic's movements become predictable, he pulls the trigger.

spans.text: S901 braces the machine gun. Once the entropic's movements become predictable, he pulls the trigger.

units.rawText: Fire!!!
units.displayText: Fire!!!

spans.text: Fire!!!

units.rawText: A hail of bullets erupts from the gun. The entropic is hit several times before it can even react and crashes to the ground.
units.displayText: A hail of bullets erupts from the gun. The entropic is hit several times before it can even react and crashes to the ground.

spans.text: A hail of bullets erupts from the gun. The entropic is hit several times before it can even react and crashes to the ground.

units.rawText: Skree—
units.displayText: Skree—

spans.text: Skree—

units.rawText: Target hit! Target hit!
units.displayText: Target hit! Target hit!

spans.text: Target hit! Target hit!

units.rawText: Mission complete! Mission complete!
units.displayText: Mission complete! Mission complete!

spans.text: Mission complete! Mission complete!

units.rawText: The excited little munchkins roll around inside the generator room. Suddenly, a tentacle forcefully tugs on their mechanical arms and slams the research agents onto a nearby transformer.
units.displayText: The excited little munchkins roll around inside the generator room. Suddenly, a tentacle forcefully tugs on their mechanical arms and slams the research agents onto a nearby transformer.

spans.text: The excited little munchkins roll around inside the generator room. Suddenly, a tentacle forcefully tugs on their mechanical arms and slams the research agents onto a nearby transformer.

units.rawText: A powerful current instantly pierces through the agent's core, and it spews black smoke. Its glowing green eyes disappear from its face-monitor...
units.displayText: A powerful current instantly pierces through the agent's core, and it spews black smoke. Its glowing green eyes disappear from its face-monitor...

spans.text: A powerful current instantly pierces through the agent's core, and it spews black smoke. Its glowing green eyes disappear from its face-monitor...

units.rawText: <size=40>G111!</size>
The heavily-wounded entropic gets back up. Sticky Liquid Entropy oozes from its wounds and drips on the ground, quickly dying its surroundings a purple color.
units.displayText: The heavily-wounded entropic gets back up. Sticky Liquid Entropy oozes from its wounds and drips on the ground, quickly dying its surroundings a purple color.

spans.text: The heavily-wounded entropic gets back up. Sticky Liquid Entropy oozes from its wounds and drips on the ground, quickly dying its surroundings a purple color.

units.rawText: Research mini-robot S901 has no time to check on G111's condition as the entropic's tentacles stab at him like spears. All it can do is flee from the generator room, dragging the machine gun behind it and drawing the entropic away from the generators.
units.displayText: Research mini-robot S901 has no time to check on G111's condition as the entropic's tentacles stab at him like spears. All it can do is flee from the generator room, dragging the machine gun behind it and drawing the entropic away from the generators.

spans.text: Research mini-robot S901 has no time to check on G111's condition as the entropic's tentacles stab at him like spears. All it can do is flee from the generator room, dragging the machine gun behind it and drawing the entropic away from the generators.

units.rawText: Over here! Over here!
units.displayText: Over here! Over here!

spans.text: Over here! Over here!

units.rawText: Skree!!
units.displayText: Skree!!

spans.text: Skree!!

units.rawText: Defend the base, defend the base, defend the base...
units.displayText: Defend the base, defend the base, defend the base...

spans.text: Defend the base, defend the base, defend the base...

units.rawText: The research mini-robots are not born fighters, and they are filled with an instinctive fear of combat. In the face of the huge monster, S901's words sound like it's trying to psych itself up.
units.displayText: The research mini-robots are not born fighters, and they are filled with an instinctive fear of combat. In the face of the huge monster, S901's words sound like it's trying to psych itself up.

spans.text: The research mini-robots are not born fighters, and they are filled with an instinctive fear of combat. In the face of the huge monster, S901's words sound like it's trying to psych itself up.

units.rawText: <size=40>FIGHT!</size>
units.displayText: FIGHT!

spans.text: FIGHT!

units.rawText: In a corridor far from the generator, S901 decides not to run anymore. Instead it picks up the machinegun, and prepares to fire at its enemies.
units.displayText: In a corridor far from the generator, S901 decides not to run anymore. Instead it picks up the machinegun, and prepares to fire at its enemies.

spans.text: In a corridor far from the generator, S901 decides not to run anymore. Instead it picks up the machinegun, and prepares to fire at its enemies.

units.rawText: Bangbangbang! Three shots later, the magazine runs dry.
units.displayText: Bangbangbang! Three shots later, the magazine runs dry.

spans.text: Bangbangbang! Three shots later, the magazine runs dry.

units.rawText: Skree—
units.displayText: Skree—

spans.text: Skree—

units.rawText: The furious entropic opens its gaping maw to roar, and the research agent holds its jaws open and jumps into its mouth. The stench of rot and decay surrounds it and Liquid Entropy eats away at its limbs.
units.displayText: The furious entropic opens its gaping maw to roar, and the research agent holds its jaws open and jumps into its mouth. The stench of rot and decay surrounds it and Liquid Entropy eats away at its limbs.

spans.text: The furious entropic opens its gaping maw to roar, and the research agent holds its jaws open and jumps into its mouth. The stench of rot and decay surrounds it and Liquid Entropy eats away at its limbs.

units.rawText: FIGHT!
units.displayText: FIGHT!

spans.text: FIGHT!

units.rawText: Core detonation program activated. Commencing countdown: 10, 9...
units.displayText: Core detonation program activated. Commencing countdown: 10, 9...

spans.text: Core detonation program activated. Commencing countdown: 10, 9...

units.rawText: Before its neural cloud is consumed by the Entropy virus, it immediately activates its self-destruct program.
units.displayText: Before its neural cloud is consumed by the Entropy virus, it immediately activates its self-destruct program.

spans.text: Before its neural cloud is consumed by the Entropy virus, it immediately activates its self-destruct program.

units.rawText: <size=40>Kaboom!!!</size>
units.displayText: Kaboom!!!

spans.text: Kaboom!!!

units.rawText: Warning— small detonation detected in the vicinity of the Herschel Laboratory.
units.displayText: Warning— small detonation detected in the vicinity of the Herschel Laboratory.

spans.text: Warning— small detonation detected in the vicinity of the Herschel Laboratory.

units.rawText: Generator complex threat index dropping. Resuming normal operations...
units.displayText: Generator complex threat index dropping. Resuming normal operations...

spans.text: Generator complex threat index dropping. Resuming normal operations...

units.rawText: The entropization's stopped! They did it!
units.displayText: The entropization's stopped! They did it!

spans.text: The entropization's stopped! They did it!

units.rawText: I need to get them back to the ship ASAP...
units.displayText: I need to get them back to the ship ASAP...

spans.text: I need to get them back to the ship ASAP...
